exp_id.physical_interpretation: Upstream primary key of the measurement row.
exp_id.notes: safe_exp_id = {file stem}_SAFE:{exp_id}; monotone within a curation batch, so numeric blocks act as a study/figure surrogate.
exp_id.recommendation: keep as a join key and grouping key only; never a feature.

upstream_source_file.physical_interpretation: Which per-metal SAFE export the row was pulled from; 66% of rows have a stem different from their own metal (co-reported measurements).

upstream_stem.physical_interpretation: Same as upstream_source_file without the suffix.

Extractant_Name.notes: 18 rows carry TWO names ('TODGA,DHOA'): a synergistic mixture kept as one composite label downstream.

Extractant_inchi.notes: populated on only 18 rows and the sole value is the placeholder '-,-'. Zero information.

Extractant_Concentration_M.notes: the 18 mixture rows carry '0.1 M,0.5 M'; downstream keeps only the first (0.1) and drops the 0.5 M DHOA co-extractant.
Extractant_Concentration_M.recommendation: recover the second concentration for the 18 mixture rows.

Solvent_Name.physical_interpretation: Organic diluent, including modifier volume fractions written into the name.
Solvent_Name.notes: 83 upstream values -> 41 one-hot categories; 305 rows (43 distinct solvents) are swallowed by cond__diluent__other. 1357 rows (22.65%) state a modifier volume fraction in the name (30%,40%,5%,50%,10%,20%,25%,12.5%,15%) that exists downstream only as unordered one-hot identity, never as a number. Explains 4.95% of the within-repeated-cell log_D SS.
Solvent_Name.recommendation: PARTIALLY MISSING: extract (base diluent, modifier identity, modifier volume fraction) as three features.

f_Solvent_Name.notes: byte-identical to Solvent_Name on every row.

Metal_Oxidation_state.notes: only value present is 'III' (5195 rows); the 797 missing rows are all set to metal_ox=3 downstream. The missingness flag itself explains 0.27% of within-cell SS (it is a curation-batch marker, not chemistry).
Metal_Oxidation_state.recommendation: already present; do NOT re-add the missingness indicator (batch proxy).

ini_comp.physical_interpretation: Comma-joined initial composition string (acid, extractant, metal, solvent[, modifier]).

Phase_Modifier_Name.physical_interpretation: Phase modifier / synergist added to the diluent (1-octanol, TBP, HDEHP, ...).
Phase_Modifier_Name.notes: only 265 rows (4.42%) carry one at all.

Phase_Modifier_Concentration_M.physical_interpretation: Molarity of the phase modifier / synergist in the organic phase.
Phase_Modifier_Concentration_M.notes: 265 rows, 15 distinct values 0.1-2.537 M. Downstream keeps the modifier IDENTITY but not HOW MUCH. Splits only 6 repeated cells and explains 0.04% of within-cell SS, so it is a small-n feature, not a replicate explainer. Physically real: 2.537 M 1-octanol vs 0.1 M changes the organic-phase activity and the extracted stoichiometry.
Phase_Modifier_Concentration_M.recommendation: TRULY MISSING - add as a numeric with 0.0 for 'no modifier' (a genuine zero, not a NaN).

Holdback_Agent_Name.physical_interpretation: Aqueous masking/holdback agent (the dedicated column for it).
Holdback_Agent_Name.notes: 0 of 5992 rows populated. The information IS present but was typed into comments_description as 'Complexant_Name' instead.
Holdback_Agent_Name.recommendation: read the complexant out of comments_description (see below), not this column.

Acid_Concentration_Organic_M.physical_interpretation: Acid co-extracted INTO the organic phase, measured after equilibration.
Acid_Concentration_Organic_M.notes: 36 rows (0.60%) only, all from ONE DOI, ONE extractant (DMDOHEMA), ONE metal (Eu). corr(org_acid, log_D)=0.85, corr(org_acid, aq_acid)=0.95. This is a post-equilibration OBSERVABLE, not a set condition: it is a second measurement on the same tube as D. Splits 0 repeated cells.
Acid_Concentration_Organic_M.recommendation: DO NOT USE AS A FEATURE. Outcome variable, unavailable at inference, and single-study.

f_Metal_Concentration_mM.physical_interpretation: Final (organic-phase) metal concentration - the numerator of D.
f_Metal_Concentration_mM.notes: 0 of 5992 rows populated on this subset. If it ever becomes populated it is D itself: D = f_Metal / (Metal - f_Metal).
f_Metal_Concentration_mM.recommendation: BLACKLIST permanently. Never join this column.

Shaking_Time_min.physical_interpretation: Agitation time - the SAME physical quantity as contact time, recorded under a different column by a different curator.
Shaking_Time_min.notes: 1067 rows (17.81%), 11 distinct values 2-120 min. Perfectly DISJOINT from Contact_Time_min (0 rows have both; 1149 rows have neither). Downstream cond__contact_time_min is NaN on all 1067 of them, so a unifiable 'equilibration time' is null on 2216 rows when it is really null on only 1149. geom_cond__shaking_time_bin exists but crushes 30/31/32/45/50/60/120 min into one 'medium' bin. Explains 0.27% of within-cell SS.
Shaking_Time_min.recommendation: TRULY MISSING as a number - build cond__equilibration_time_min = coalesce(Contact_Time_min, Shaking_Time_min) plus a binary flag for which one it was; raises coverage 63.0% -> 80.8%.

Radiolytic_Dosage_kGy.physical_interpretation: Absorbed gamma dose on the solvent (degradation studies).

obsTemp.physical_interpretation: Literal string 'Temperature' - a field label, not a value.

volType.physical_interpretation: Literal 'Volume Ratio' - marks that an O:A phase ratio was recorded.
volType.notes: present on exactly the 3388 rows curated by Thomas Summers; 0 on the other 2604. It is a CURATOR-BATCH marker, not a physical variable. geom_cond__phase_ratio_bin is 'missing' for all 5992 rows.
volType.recommendation: do not use: it is a perfect proxy for entry_author=='Thomas Summers'.

volValue.notes: 3388 rows, and the ONLY value is 1.0. Zero variance -> the number carries no information; only its presence/absence does, and that is the curator-batch marker above. Explains 0.00% of within-cell SS.
volValue.recommendation: do not add. Record in the manifest that O:A ratio is unrecoverable (assumed 1:1 everywhere it is stated).

obsDvaluesValue.equivalence: exact - IT IS THE TARGET (5992/5992 agree to 1e-6)
obsDvaluesValue.notes: This proves any wholesale join of the upstream tables imports the label. reconstruct_provenance.py already guards this by excluding raw upstream columns from provenance_table.parquet unless --include-upstream-columns is passed.

obsTotalEnergiesUnit.physical_interpretation: Unit label for an energy observation.

DOI.physical_interpretation: Comma-separated citation list; always includes the SAFE compilation self-citation 10.1021/jacs.5c19738.
DOI.notes: 115 raw strings -> the canonicaliser in gen6/provenance.py folds notation variants. Group-mean of log_D by DOI alone reaches R2 = 0.4171; DOI x Data-Location reaches R2 = 0.5001. Splits 17 repeated cells (0.32% of within-cell SS).
DOI.recommendation: GROUPING VARIABLE ONLY - use for study-aware splits and for auditing cross-study averaging. Never a feature.

entry_author.physical_interpretation: Curator who entered the row (3 people).
entry_author.notes: Thomas Summers 3388 / Baosen Zhang 1423 / Aurora Clark 1181. Group-mean R2 = 0.1232. Determines which comment schema, whether volType is present, and whether Metal_Oxidation_state was filled in - i.e. it explains missingness patterns, not chemistry.
entry_author.recommendation: diagnostic only; use to check that fold structure is not curator-confounded.

addition_date.physical_interpretation: Timestamp the row was typed into the database (543 distinct, only 4 distinct DAYS).
addition_date.notes: Group-mean R2 by full timestamp = 0.6474 (by day only 0.1258). Inside repeated condition cells it explains 83.1% of the log_D sum of squares - more than any physical variable - because consecutive seconds of typing correspond to consecutive points of ONE figure curve. It is a near-perfect experiment-series surrogate.
addition_date.recommendation: GROUPING VARIABLE ONLY. Using it as a feature would be the single worst leak available in this dataset.

comments_description.physical_interpretation: One free-text field carrying two different schemas: a semi-structured 'Data Location: ...; Complexant_Name: ...; ...' blob on 3388 rows (exactly the Thomas Summers batch) and a figure caption ('fig3 ... extraction:nan', 'updated ORNL', 'IDEaL') on the other 2604.
comments_description.notes: 634 distinct strings. Contains at least 12 parseable sub-fields, listed separately below. Splits 104 repeated cells.
comments_description.recommendation: PARSE IT, then drop the raw text. Some sub-fields are real chemistry; the rest are publication bookkeeping.

comments_description::Complexant_Name.physical_interpretation: AQUEOUS-PHASE COMPLEXANT / HOLDBACK AGENT. DTPA, HEDTA, CDTA (aminopolycarboxylate holdbacks), TEDGA and DOODA(C2) (hydrophilic diglycolamide strippers), BTP-4Me, malonamide, amic acid, and NaNO3 (salting-out salt). These are added precisely to SUPPRESS extraction of the metal.
comments_description::Complexant_Name.notes: 557 rows (9.30%), 9 distinct agents. THE SINGLE LARGEST RECOVERABLE PHYSICAL VARIABLE: it explains 55.96% of the within-repeated-cell log_D sum of squares (962 rows in 304 cells, rms spread 0.591 log units) and splits 51 of those cells. Within the 40 (extractant, metal, [acid], [extractant conc]) cells that contain both, adding a complexant shifts log_D by a mean of -0.918 (median -1.071). Every metal (14) and 2-3 extractants per agent, so it is not a single-study artefact for the big agents.
comments_description::Complexant_Name.recommendation: TRULY MISSING - top-priority recovery. Encode as complexant identity one-hot + complexant present flag (+ SMILES-derived descriptors, which are already available in the blob).

comments_description::Complexant_Concent.physical_interpretation: Molarity of each aqueous complexant (semicolon-separated when there are two, e.g. '0.01; 1' = 0.01 M DTPA + 1 M NaNO3).
comments_description::Complexant_Concent.notes: 557 rows, 25 distinct strings. Explains 56.67% of within-repeated-cell SS and splits 106 cells - the best single explainer measured. Must be split on ';' and aligned positionally with Complexant_Name.
comments_description::Complexant_Concent.recommendation: TRULY MISSING - recover as log10 concentration per agent class; this is the natural partner of the MASSACTION block.

comments_description::Complexant_SMILES.physical_interpretation: Structure of each aqueous complexant (9 distinct, incl. the DTPA.nitrate salt written as a dot-disconnected SMILES).
comments_description::Complexant_SMILES.notes: 557 rows. Lets the complexant be described by the same 2D/3D descriptor machinery already built for the extractant, so a NEW holdback agent generalises instead of being a one-hot.
comments_description::Complexant_SMILES.recommendation: TRULY MISSING - recover; feed through the existing ligand-descriptor path.

comments_description::No_of_Metals.physical_interpretation: How many metals were present in the same aqueous phase - i.e. single-metal vs competitive/loaded extraction.
comments_description::No_of_Metals.notes: 3388 rows carry it (3061 = 1 metal, 327 = 2..33 metals). Explains only 0.02% of within-cell SS (the mixtures rarely coincide with repeated cells) but it is a real regime flag: mean log_D 0.618 (single) vs 0.778 (mixture). Coverage is capped at 56.5% because the other curator batch never recorded it.
comments_description::No_of_Metals.recommendation: TRULY MISSING - recover as n_metals plus an is_mixture flag, with an explicit 'unknown' level for the 2604 uncovered rows.
